fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Deletion Protection
fields.help: Set to true to make the logical view protected against deletion.

fields.label: Instance
fields.help: The name of the instance to create the logical view within.

fields.label: Logical View ID
